title: Plan (input, contract v1)
description: A plan: the turns of a piece of work in order, each turn's stories, and each story's subagents, from which agentspace lease create picks a lease's size. On the command line, --plan names a UTF-8 JSON file that holds this document; a create request's plan member holds it as an object, and lease-create.input.schema.json copies these $defs. Unknown members are refused everywhere, and so is null as any member's value: an optional member that is not given is left out. Names are compared exactly, never trimmed or case-folded; model and effort are recorded as given and read by no sizing. Anchored patterns end with $(?!\n), since $ alone matches before a final line feed in .NET and Python. What this schema cannot check, and the program checks (docs/lease-api.md, Values, Plan): a cycle in after, a subagent after itself included; an after entry that names no subagent of the same story; two turns of one name, two stories of one turn of one name, or two subagents of one story of one name; two members of one name in one object; a file larger than 262144 bytes, a byte order mark counted; a byte order mark anywhere but the file's start; and bytes that are not UTF-8.

plan.description: A plan document: an optional name, such as its epic's, and its turns in order.

name.description: The plan's name, printed as sized_for.plan. Absent means the plan has none.

turns.description: The plan's turns in order, 1 to 32.

plan_turn.description: A turn: its name, unique in the plan, and its stories, which run at once.

plan_story.description: A story: its name, unique in its turn, and its subagents. Its peak is counted from the subagents' after lists, never stated.

plan_subagent.description: A subagent: its name, unique in its story, its model and effort, and the subagents of the same story it starts after.

after.description: The names of the same story's subagents this one starts after, each once, at most 31. Absent or empty means it starts after none.

plan_name.description: A name in a plan, as given: 1 to 64 printable ASCII characters, not starting or ending with a space. Never trimmed or case-folded.

plan_model_or_effort.description: A model or an effort, as given: 1 to 32 ASCII letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-', starting with a letter or digit. Never a list of names, so a new model or effort needs no new version.
